get_rank: get the current process rank in a PyTorch distributed training job
get_world_size: get the total number of processes in a PyTorch distributed training job
get_default_group: get the default WORLD process group for PyTorch distributed communication
all_reduce: perform an all-reduce operation on a tensor across all processes in a distributed group
all_gather_list: gather arbitrary picklable Python data from all workers into a list across a distributed group
